post.summary: Record goods received from a supplier or production
post.description: Raises the item's stock by qtyArrived in the same transaction and records audit logs. statusQc is the result of the manual QC check, not derived from the quantities. A receipt against a PO sends purchaseOrderId and purchaseOrderLineId together: supplierId and qtyPurchased are then taken from the PO and the client's values are ignored (a different supplierId is a 400), qtyArrived must be at most the line's sisa, and source must be SUPPLIER. The PO is locked for the check, so concurrent receipts cannot take the same remaining qty twice. 404 for an unknown PO, 409 for a cancelled one, 400 when the line does not belong to the PO or the item does not match the line. Without a PO, source SUPPLIER (the default) and no supplierId takes the item's mapped supplier; 400 when the item has none. qtyPurchased is optional. Optional Idempotency-Key header (8 to 100 characters): with it, the same key and payload within 24 hours returns the stored answer with the same status and header Idempotency-Replayed: true and does not repeat the write; the same key with a different payload is 409; a malformed key is 400. Without it the request behaves as before.

post.summary: Record several received items in one request
post.description: Needs inbound.create and an Idempotency-Key header (8 to 100 characters, one per draft). All lines or none: one database transaction, stock raised under a row lock per item. lines holds 1 to 200 entries, qtyArrived is at most 100000 per line. purchaseOrderId and purchaseOrderLineId go per line, because one document may receive goods of several POs; supplierId and qtyPurchased are then taken from the PO, qtyArrived must be at most that line's sisa (several lines of the same PO in one request share the remaining qty), and a cancelled or unknown PO fails the whole request (409 or 404). Without a PO, supplierId comes from items.supplierId for source SUPPLIER; a line whose item has no supplier, or an unknown itemId, fails the whole request with 400 and errors keyed lines.<index>.itemId (index from 0), and nothing is written. Same key and same payload within 24 hours returns the stored answer with the same status and header Idempotency-Replayed: true, without adding stock again. Same key with a different payload is 409. A missing or malformed key is 400. A failed request stores no key, so it can be corrected and sent again with the same key.

post.summary: Record a scanner session: goods that passed QC and goods returned to the supplier
post.description: Needs inbound.create and an Idempotency-Key header (8 to 100 characters), with the same replay rules as POST /inbound/batch: same key and payload within 24 hours returns the stored answer with Idempotency-Replayed: true and adds nothing, same key with a different payload is 409. pass lines are SUPPLIER receipts with statusQc PASS and raise stock. retur lines are only recorded as a return to the item's supplier, one return request per supplier, and never change stock. Both take supplierId from items.supplierId. pass and retur each hold 0 to 200 lines, at least one line in total, qty at most 100000 per line, reason 1 to 255 characters. All or nothing: a bad line fails the whole request with 400 and errors keyed pass.<index>.<field> or retur.<index>.<field>, index from 0, for example retur.2.itemId for an unknown item or an item without a supplier.

Without spk, clientName is null. A clientName in the body is ignored.
